explanations.6: @media print means these styles only apply when someone prints the page, not when viewing it normally in a browser.
explanations.8: The content property with those backslash codes (\1F9AB and \2014) are Unicode characters — the meerkat emoji and an em dash — that will appear at the bottom of printed pages.
explanations.9: position: fixed here doesn't work the same way it does on screen; in print, it anchors the text to that spot on every printed page.
